request.prompt:
日常随行航拍。设计一台便于日常携带的航拍四旋翼。
四个电机各装一副静止、完全展开的双叶螺旋桨，每个电机只装两片桨叶。
目标部位：航拍相机舱与机身，四处臂根与机身。
本次改变：保持紧凑，让相机舱与主壳、机臂与机身的接合边界容易辨认。
保持：机头朝画面上沿。机载相机朝画面上沿的地平线平视拍摄。制图者从飞机正上方看见相机外壳的顶面，前向镜面在这个视角接近一条边。机身冷灰色。
自由项：舱体安装、机身轮廓、臂根曲面和分件。
Propulsion: 5-inch 2-blade propellers; motor tilt 0°.
4 个电机，True X 布局。最大电机中心距设计值 250 mm，相邻夹角从 R1 起顺时针为 90、90、90、90°。
随附正交俯视定位图，机头朝上，红点定位电机轴心。蓝线表示机架连接。
输出正交俯视产品图，制图观察方向从无人机正上方垂直向下，机头指向画面上沿，完整显示所有电机轴心和桨叶。保持各轴心在定位图画幅内的归一化位置和留白。
浅色中性背景，照片级工业产品设计渲染，柔和棚拍侧光与接触阴影，画面无辅助线、刻度或文字。

configurator_design_fields.instruction:
探索适合日常携带的整机方案。
保留四个电机轴心、相连的机臂和前向相机。
机身外轮廓、相机安装位置与接合方式、机臂过渡、壳体曲面和分件可探索。

provider_revised_prompt: The four-point X-shaped motor layout with two intersecting diagonal blue lines and four red dots at the corners in <Picture 1> is <Subject 1>. The target image shows a photorealistic orthographic top-down industrial design rendering of a compact everyday portable quadcopter drone positioned directly over the alignment positions of <Subject 1> against a light neutral background. <Subject 1> supplies the exact spatial placement, normalized canvas proportions, margin whitespace, and true-X frame topology transferred to the drone's four motors and structural arms, while its flat graphic lines and dots are replaced by the three-dimensional hardware. Viewed vertically from directly above with the nose pointing toward the top edge of the frame, the drone features a cool-gray main fuselage shell with clearly defined part seams and distinct curved root transitions where the four slender structural arms join the central body along the diagonal paths of <Subject 1>. At each of the four corner axis centers marked by <Subject 1>, an upright zero-degree-tilt brushless motor is mounted on the arm tip, fitted with a stationary, fully unfolded 5-inch two-blade propeller consisting of exactly two sleek dark-gray blades per motor, all completely visible within the frame. Beneath the front section of the fuselage, a forward-mounted aerial camera pod extends slightly ahead of the main shell; seen from this strict overhead projection, the top surface of the camera housing is visible while its forward-facing lens plane aligns nearly edge-on toward the top border, aimed level toward the horizon. Soft studio side lighting models the matte cool-gray composite surfaces, subtle bevels, and recessed panel gaps, casting gentle contact shadows onto the clean, unlined light neutral background without any auxiliary graphics, scale marks, or text.
